title: Autumn Apple Strudel
description: A traditional German dessert, this strudel is filled with tender apples and spices, topped with a crumbly streusel topping.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other tart variety

instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped apples, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and flour. Mix well.
Roll out the strudel dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spread the apple mixture evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll the dough into a tight log, starting from one of the long edges.
Place the log on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, seam-side down.
Brush the top of the log with the melted butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the strudel is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the strudel into thick rounds and serve warm.
